multiplier.averageRuleTitle: Equal averages across tiers and providers
multiplier.basePlaceholder: Enter the CNY amount for one reference request
multiplier.benchmarkHint: Enter input and output prices per million tokens in the selected currency.
multiplier.calculationSteps: Average input and output tiers separately, calculate the reference amount for each eligible provider, then average provider amounts equally. Convert USD amounts to CNY using the display rate first.
multiplier.currencyHint: Switching currency keeps entered numbers without conversion. USD prices are converted to CNY using the display exchange rate.
multiplier.dynamicModelDescription: Auto, Max and other dynamic models use the real model resolved for the current user and its eligible providers.
multiplier.dynamicModelTitle: Dynamic models follow the resolved model
multiplier.enabled: Show multipliers in the model list
multiplier.enabledHint: For reference only. Actual billing is unchanged.
multiplier.examplesHint: Change base prices to compare multipliers. Changing the exchange rate also updates CNY amounts. Examples are not platform selling prices.
multiplier.exchangeRateUnit: CNY / USD. For display only; settlement rates are unchanged.
multiplier.explanation: Multipliers compare base language model selling prices and do not change billing. Reference usage is 10,000 input tokens and 1,000 output tokens. Tier unit prices are averaged equally, then reference amounts are averaged equally across eligible providers. USD prices use the display exchange rate before division by the 1x base price. Providers missing either input or output prices or a convertible currency are excluded; explicit zero prices participate. If all prices are missing, 0.00x is shown, so 0.00x does not necessarily mean free. Dynamic models use the actual model resolved for the current user. Multipliers exclude subscription, promotional, cache and time-based discounts. Actual charges follow real usage and billing rules. Values use two decimals; positive values below 0.01 show <0.01x. Changes appear on the next model list refresh. The display rate does not affect the settlement rate.
multiplier.formula: Reference usage: 10,000 input + 1,000 output tokens, without caching. Multiplier = average provider reference amount (CNY) / 1x base price.
multiplier.invalidAmount: Enter a positive decimal with up to 12 integer and 12 fractional digits.
multiplier.invalidPrices: Enter non-negative decimal prices, not both zero, with up to 12 integer and 12 fractional digits.
multiplier.missingPriceDescription: Skip providers without input/output prices or a convertible currency. Explicit zero prices participate. All prices missing displays 0.00x, which does not necessarily mean free.
multiplier.previewHint: Preview for checking only. The backend response determines the saved reference amount.
multiplier.priceScopeDescription: Compare base selling prices, not costs. Excludes plans, promotions, caching and time-based discounts. Actual billing follows real usage and billing rules.
multiplier.referenceUsageSummary: Based on 10,000 input + 1,000 output tokens, without caching.
multiplier.refreshDescription: Examples update immediately. After saving, users see new multipliers when refreshing the model list. Disable display to hide them. Two decimal places; positive values below 0.01 display <0.01x. Display rates do not change settlement rates.
multiplier.shortFormula: Model reference amount ÷ base reference amount = display multiplier
multiplier.snapshotHint: Prices checked: 2026-10-15. Standard API text input/output, without caching, batch or off-peak discounts. Official prices stay fixed when the benchmark changes. Examples use a single official channel and do not represent platform prices, model availability or live quotes.
multiplier.tierSources: Tier sources (USD / million tokens): GPT-5.4 input 2.50 / 5.00, output 15.00 / 22.50; Gemini input 2.00 / 4.00, output 12.00 / 18.00; Qwen international input 0.50 / 2.00, output 3.00 / 6.00. Each is equally averaged. DeepSeek uses peak prices without off-peak discounts.
multiplier.title: Model reference multiplier
multiplier.usageRuleDescription: 10,000 input + 1,000 output tokens, without cache. Reference amount = input price × 0.01 + output price × 0.001. USD amounts are multiplied by the display exchange rate to obtain CNY.
